instruction: Put the yellow book in the purple box.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
obj = obs["objects"]["yellow_book"]
zone = obs["zones"]["purple_box"]
center = zone["center"]
half_size = zone["half_size"]

# Check if purple_box is occupied by another object
occupied = False
for name, other_obj in obs["objects"].items():
    if name == "yellow_book":
        continue
    if (abs(other_obj["center"][0] - center[0]) < half_size[0] and
        abs(other_obj["center"][1] - center[1]) < half_size[1] and
        other_obj["top_z"] > center[2] + 0.005):
        # Clear the zone by placing the occupying object elsewhere
        place("cyan_tray", dx=0.02, dy=0.02)
        wait(20)
        occupied = True
        break

# Pick up yellow_book with appropriate grasp parameters
grasp_height = 0.02
yaw = obj["long_axis_yaw"] + 1.17  # 67 degrees in radians
pick("yellow_book", grasp_height, yaw)
wait(20)

# Place the book in the purple_box
place("purple_box")
wait(20)
